system.description: If your Rank in this Skill is equal to or greater than your CON, you heal 1 Health Bar slot at the start of each round (or every 10 seconds outside of combat). If not, you heal 1 Health Bar slot every other round (or every 20 seconds outside of combat).

upgrades.description: After 5 minutes, any Minor Injury Debuff you suffer from ends. After 10 minutes, any Major Injury Debuff you suffer from ends.
After 20 minutes, any Long-Term Minor Injury Debuff you suffer from ends. After 1 hour, any Long-Term Major Injury Debuff you suffer from ends.
The time required to end injury Debuffs is halved.
